max_direct_files.description: Allowed direct-file ceiling for an existing violation.

path.description: Repository-relative directory path. The repository root is `""`.

role.description: Production or test role measured at the directory.

FileByteLimit.description:
Largest size, in bytes, that a file may have.

Configuration uses it for `max_bytes_per_file`, and the ratchet file for the ceiling of a file
that was already too large.

max_lines.description: Allowed line ceiling for an existing violation.

allOf.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.

role.description: Production or test role measured at the file.

anyOf.description: Ceiling for a regular file, in bytes.
Ceiling for a file with the storage it names.

FileSizeEntry.description: How the ratchet file writes one byte ceiling.

FileStorage.description: How a file's content is stored, which decides the byte limit that applies to it.

oneOf.description: The file's content is stored as is, so `max_bytes_per_file` limits its size on disk.

Git LFS stores the file's content and the repository holds only a small pointer to it, so
`max_bytes_per_lfs_object` limits the size of the content.

RelativePath.description: Normalized repository-relative path using forward slash separators.

SourceKind.description: Production or test role assigned to an included source file.

oneOf.description: Source file classified as test code.

StoredFileSize.description: Byte ceiling that names how the file's content was stored.

max_bytes.description: Largest size, in bytes, the file may grow back to.

storage.description: How the file's content was stored, which decides the byte limit it was over.

description:
Measured ceilings for current violations.

The file omits language, ownership, reasons, and configured limits. Checks derive those values
from source classification and the configured limits.

directories.description: Directory direct-file count ceilings for both source roles.

file_sizes.description:
Byte ceilings for files that were already larger than their byte limit, keyed by
repository-relative file path.

files.description: File line ceilings for both source roles.
